name: The random director, seed 1: no woman on a late shift
description: The random director alone. On Friday 20 November Shanice (the late CA) is off sick; the agency carer who covers her and the agency nurse are both men, and Dave leads, so from 14:40 to 21:30 there is no woman on shift. Peggy (female carers only) asks for the toilet at 14:53 and waits 404 minutes, until the night carer arrives. Nothing escalates it (the floating carer and the main building are night-time help only).
